d:
The United States is tightening its pressure campaign against Iran. After imposing a naval blockade, Washington has launched Task Force Iron Gate to disrupt the movement of weapons, sanctioned materials and supplies through Iran's land routes and the Caspian Sea.
Tehran has responded by lifting its self-imposed 2,000-kilometre limit on ballistic missile range. The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has also warned that it has new weapons ready to be deployed if fighting resumes, promising strikes that will astonish the world.
